title: senna glutinosa subsp. charlesiana
intro: Senna glutinosa subsp. charlesiana, commonly known as Charles's senna or Charles's cassia, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and relieve constipation, thanks to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna glutinosa subsp. charlesiana include its anthelmintic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
